name: JoAi: Create Automation

description.en: Create a lifecycle automation (wait → send email → halt). Triggers on contact prop or segment — not tags. Separate from oneshot campaigns.
description.de: Erstellt eine Lifecycle-Automation (wait → E-Mail → halt). Trigger über Kontakt-Prop oder Segment — keine Tags. Getrennt von einmaligen Kampagnen.
description.fr: Crée une automatisation de cycle de vie (wait → e-mail → halt). Déclenchée par une prop contact ou un segment — pas de tags. Distincte des campagnes ponctuelles.
description.es: Crea una automatización de ciclo de vida (wait → email → halt). Se dispara por prop de contacto o segmento — no por tags. Separada de las campañas puntuales.
description.it: Crea un'automazione di ciclo di vita (wait → email → halt). Si attiva su prop contatto o segmento — non su tag. Separata dalle campagne one-shot.
description.ro: Creează o automatizare pe ciclu de viață (wait → email → halt). Declanșată de o prop de contact sau segment — nu de tag-uri. Separată de campaniile one-shot.

bot: Use for delayed welcome/drip emails. Prefer prop onboarding-stage=done. Pass actions as JSON array: wait → send_email → halt. Campaigns remain for newsletters/backfill. enabled: pass 1 or 0.

inputs.name: Trigger type
inputs.bot: prop (contact property), segment, or manual (run_automation only).

inputs.name: Actions
inputs.bot: Ordered JSON array. Example: [{"type":"wait","config":{"delayMinutes":4320}},{"type":"send_email","config":{"subject":"…","body":"Hallo {{name}}"}},{"type":"halt","config":{}}]. Wait config is only delayMinutes, a whole number of minutes (0 = immediate). At most one send_email. Send config is subject, body, and optional contentHtml.

inputs.name: Agent ID
inputs.bot: Sending agent UUID. Required when actions include send_email. The agent must have email configured. There is no team-wide fallback.

error.fr: Échec de la création de l'automatisation : {{MESSAGE}}
error.es: No se pudo crear la automatización: {{MESSAGE}}
